libheif-1.23.7.js is the unmodified src/lib/libheif-without-unsafe-eval.js from
heic-to 1.6.7. SHA-256: 75aaf03816c22f8cf40dbcaeb22bee83f2e1c5da4b7417577a7883b296348734.
It is a separately loaded, replaceable JavaScript library built from libheif
1.23.7 and libde265 1.0.16. These libraries are copyright struktur AG,
Dirk Farin and their respective contributors. See the accompanying COPYING
files for the GNU Lesser General Public License v3 and GNU GPL v3.

Published package (including the unmodified generated source):
https://registry.npmjs.org/heic-to/-/heic-to-1.6.7.tgz
Build instructions, exact package revision:
https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to/tree/78345a3fcdb4a1d70d513fce2646aeff0127f7ba
Corresponding upstream C/C++ sources and Emscripten build scripts:
https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/archive/refs/tags/v1.23.7.tar.gz
https://github.com/strukturag/libde265/archive/refs/tags/v1.0.16.tar.gz
The package build uses LIBDE265_VERSION=1.0.16 USE_WASM=0 USE_UNSAFE_EVAL=0.
To replace the library, substitute a compatible default factory ES module at
the same file path. Application code is maintained in crew-heif-worker.js.
